explanation: The theorem concerns `ContinuousLinearMap.factorThru`, which this library defines itself (Factor.lean line 106). It extends T along the range of A and composes with the orthogonal projection onto the closure of that range. Mathlib has no `ContinuousLinearMap.factorThru`. The only `factorThru` declarations I found in Mathlib are the category-theory and subobject ones, which are unrelated. `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Extend.lean` has the `extendOfNorm` ingredient, but no result about the norm of such a factor. The proof itself applies the library's own `norm_factorThru_apply` plus the fact that the closure of the range is everything when A has dense range. The mathematical content lies in the library's own definition, so I found no duplicate.
